# Semantic coverage

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

Spec v3 sections 50 and 53.

## Artifact-level comparison

**Not performed.** No AiExport artifact is present in `source/`, so there is no pair to compare. Per spec v3 section 54 no compatibility percentage is produced.

## Schema-level coverage

This does not need a pair. The embedded profile declares, for each AiExport
record type, the legacy table it projects from — so the two formats' concept
coverage can be compared directly at the schema level.
